extracted.intended_audience: Prospective applicants to the Helen Hay Whitney Foundation Research Fellowship (postdoctoral applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and mandatory requirements for submitting an online application to the Helen Hay Whitney Foundation Research Fellowship via Altum | Proposal Central, including deadlines, letter-writer registration, and contact procedures for technical and non-technical issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application submission platform
rubrics_metrics.description: To apply, please log into Altum | Proposal Central and search for ‘Helen Hay Whitney Foundation'. (Alternatively, you can click here for a direct link to the program.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application instructions and relevant forms are available on Proposal Central. All applications must be submitted through Proposal Central.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline (submission cutoff)
rubrics_metrics.description: The next application deadline is Monday, June 15, 2026, 5:00pm EST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Application must be submitted through Proposal Central by 5:00pm EST on June 15, 2026. Ensure submission is completed before this exact time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Download and read application instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please download the instructions here and read carefully before attempting to complete the online application submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the provided instructions thoroughly prior to beginning the online application to avoid errors or omissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register letter writers early (Sections 1 and 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: The information to be entered in both Sections 1 and 2 should be done immediately, as early as possible, WELL IN ADVANCE OF THE DEADLINE, to register your letter writers so that they can receive an auto-generated email notification with a custom upload link, TO ALLOW AMPLE TIME FOR THEM TO UPLOAD THEIR OWN LETTERS BEFORE THE JUNE 15TH DEADLINE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter Sections 1 and 2 early to trigger the system-generated email with a custom upload link for referees; do not wait until the deadline to register letter writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: Here is a link to the FAQs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FAQs for common questions about the application process before contacting staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical support contact and hours
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are experiencing technical problems with our online application, please contact Proposal Central. During normal business hours: 8:30am – 5:00pm Eastern Time (Monday through Friday) by phone (toll-free): 800 875 2562 (Toll-free U.S. and Canada) or +1 703 964 5840 (Direct Dial International) by email: support@proposalcentral.com. If emailing them, please ALSO cc Robert Weinberger at rweinberger@hhhf.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact Proposal Central for technical issues only, within the stated business hours. When emailing Proposal Central, cc Robert Weinberger as instructed to ensure awareness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-technical application issues contact
rubrics_metrics.description: For all non-technical application issues, only email Robert Weinberger at rweinberger@hhhf.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct non-technical questions solely to Robert Weinberger (do not route non-technical issues through Proposal Central support).
